name: codex-threadctl
description: Codex skill for finding agent trees, inspecting threads, and applying app-server-backed control.

interface.shortDescription: Find, inspect, and control Codex threads
interface.longDescription: Codex Threadctl provides guidance for discovering persisted threads and spawned-agent trees, resolving v2 paths, inspecting activity, context, messages, and terminal processes, and applying immediate app-server control within native ownership boundaries.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $codex-threadctl to find, inspect, or immediately control a Codex thread.
